disclosure: Placeholder fact-bearing token list pending Aaron's balance pass (the balance-number regime: player-felt numbers are placeholder + directional tests + delegated proposal + row-by-row approval). SEC-148 (engine.news FactLock): the fact-lock must reject a rewrite that silently swaps the prose's meaning even when the numbers and the named entity survive — '2 deaths' to '2 births', 'record set in March' to 'record set in April'. §29 names the five categories but not the prose vocabulary that carries a story's meaning, so this token list is data (GR#15) rather than a code literal; the binding property today is that a rewrite whose set of fact-bearing tokens differs from the original is rejected. The list is deliberately a conservative starter set (event-type words + their plurals, month names, before/after); it is NOT the §29 category vocabulary ('first'/'crisis'/'milestone' are excluded to avoid colliding with road names like 'First Street'), and adding or removing tokens is a data edit, never a code change.
